scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run prepare:wrangler && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:worker
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run deploy:worker
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run prepare:wrangler && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run prepare:wrangler && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
